title: Viewing the AI Data Access Dashboard

blocks.text: DSPM scans and identifies AI services and models that have access to data stores containing sensitive data, and displays this information on the AI Data Access dashboard.
The following widgets are shown. You can apply filters to view data specific to clouds, business units, accounts, and regions.

blocks.item: View metrics related to the AI services deployed in your cloud environment.
Deployed AI: The number of AI services deployed across the cloud environment. Click the tile to view the AI service details on the Resource Inventory page.
Data Shared with AI: The number of data stores and files that can be accessed by the AI services. Click the number to view additional details on the Resource Inventory page.
Open Alerts on AI Resources: The number of open alerts triggered for misconfigurations detected in the AI services. Click the tile to view additional details on the Alerts page.
Data Exposed to AI by Services

AI services might use sanctioned or unsanctioned AI models that are deployed through managed cloud service providers or self-managed cloud infrastructures. Some of these models could be potentially risky and expose sensitive data, leading to data breaches. It is crucial to monitor the AI models to detect and resolve vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, protect sensitive data, and maintain compliance.
The total number of data stores that are discovered and scanned. Click the number to view additional details on the Resource Inventory page.
The following tabs include additional details:

Gen AI Classification: The chart displays the files classified using Gen AI. Click each circle to view a specific file type discovered in different data stores. Click the number to view additional details on the Resource Inventory page.

DLP Engines: The chart displays the number of DLP engines used for data classification. Click each circle to view the total number of files classified in different data stores and triggers in various regions. Click the number to view additional details on the Resource Inventory page. Select the Show Sensitive Data Only checkbox to view only those DLP engines that are marked as sensitive.
